text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated embeddings latency and sporadic 504s in eu-central since 10:15 UTC. Approx 0.8-2% of embedding ops affected. Were throttling cross-region cache invalidations and routing traffic to warmed caches. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2351239999

rachel.sre: seeing cache invalidation flood from a recent rollout; invalidations hitting embed-store replicas, IO spike + longer compaction windows. p95/p99 up.

theo.eng: confirmed that the rollout toggled aggressive global-invalidate=true flag. that kicked off mass prefix invalidations.

rachel.sre: starting to suspend inter-region invalidation queue at 10:20 UTC, will let local TTLs expire instead. throttling applied.

laura.support: drafting customer message: "We observed higher-than-normal embedding latency and occasional timeouts in EU-CENTRAL affecting a small subset of requests. Mitigation in progress." Q: do we need to advise retries/backoff?

theo.eng: yes please add recommended exponential backoff (up to 3 retries) and note were prioritizing successful reads over immediate global invalidation.

deploy-bot: Rollout action: feature-flag global-invalidate set to false for embedding-cleaner at 10:24 UTC by theo.eng.

rachel.sre: after throttle and flag flip, error rate dropping to 0.4% at 10:31 UTC. IO pressure easing; compactions returning to normal cadence.

celine.pm: ETA on full recovery? customers want timing and RCA.

rachel.sre: estimate 25-40 minutes for residual cache warm and compaction catch-up. will update when errors <0.25% for 5m.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Metrics back to baseline (0.18% errors) at 10:50 UTC. Mitigation summary: suspended cross-region invalidation queue, toggled feature flag off on embedding-cleaner, routed reads to warmed replicas. No customer data loss detected. Postmortem scheduled 2026-04-02 14:00 UTC in #incidents-postmortems. Runbook: https://status.redwood.ai/runbooks/embed-invalidation-throttle

laura.support: customer note published and pinned in #customer-updates. link sent to impacted customers.

celine.pm: thanks all. please drop detailed timeline, error graphs, and the change that triggered this into the postmortem doc. owners: rachel.sre (ops timeline), theo.eng (root cause + fix), laura.support (customer comms). :white_check_mark:
